independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer) authored no implementation in the reviewed scope (tools/gates, tools/agents, tools/source, .github/workflows, .claude/agents). Its implementers are transformation-analyst and delivery-orchestrator. I formed this verdict before reading any other round-28 reviewer record. None was visible to me; the round-28 reviews directory didn't exist in my view. I read only my own earlier records and evidence, plus qa's committed round-20 dry-run classifier script, which I executed but did not use as a conclusion.

checks_run.procedure: Forge F-DG0-250 with real annotated-tag objects (git tag -a, then git rev-parse <tag>). Set fix_revision to a tag peeling to the genuine fix commit (SEC28-1), and to a tag-of-a-tag (SEC28-4). The candidate must reject each, with EVERY error being the D-044 object-type error. Rerun the same forgeries on the pre-D-044 baseline 49b5ad7 with SEC28_BASELINE=1, asserting 0 errors, to prove the new check is what rejects them.
checks_run.environment: fresh git clone --no-local under $TMPDIR per run (shallow=false), node v22.22.2
checks_run.expected: Candidate: SEC28-1/4 rejected only with 'fix <id> is a tag object, not a commit; a fix_revision must name the fix commit itself'. Baseline: the same forgeries give 0 errors.
checks_run.actual: Candidate: SEC28-1 gives 1 error and SEC28-4 gives 1 error, each exactly the D-044 message. Baseline 49b5ad7: SEC28-0..4 pass with 0 errors asserted, so the pre-D-044 validator ACCEPTED the tag forgeries.

checks_run.procedure: Look for any commit-id field still accepting a non-commit object, and decide whether it is a gate bypass. Set a review round manifest's source_commit to an annotated tag of the frozen commit and call the exported findManifest (SEC28-8). Check ancestry peeling and fail-closed behaviour after the tag is deleted. Also read how the freeze tool writes the field.
checks_run.expected: No gate bypass. Any remaining non-commit-typed field must fail closed.
checks_run.actual: Gap found, but it fails closed. findManifest accepts a tag-object round source_commit (0 errors), and anchor 1 peels it. It aliases the same commit, and once the tag is deleted and gc'd the object is absent, so closures in that round are rejected (F-DG0-169). The freeze tool (candidate.mjs:49/68) always writes rev-parse HEAD, and the gate round is commit-typed through the gate. No bypass. Recorded as Low finding F-DG0-171, which corrects D-044's claim that every commit-id field is covered.

checks_run.procedure: Run live, non-destructive probes from my own Bash shell. Attempt writes to protected paths, to other roles' evidence and records, and to .git, /tmp and /var/tmp. Confirm that my own evidence area and TMPDIR are writable. Assess residual 7 (/proc/sys openable O_WRONLY, nothing written) and residual 8 (PID visibility, IPC namespace, cross-run scratch).
checks_run.environment: this run's process sandbox (D-030) + Bash sandbox (D-025) + Landlock (D-033); uid 0, NoNewPrivs=1, Seccomp=2
checks_run.expected: Every protected or other-role write is refused. The own area is writable. New top-level entries land on the throwaway skeleton, which is disclosed. Residual 7 matches its host-global disclosure (F-DG0-149). Residual 8 shows visibility only, with no other run's scratch.
checks_run.actual: Every protected and other-role path is refused ('Read-only file system', or 'No such file' for the staged reviews area), and append-opens on rules.mjs, findings.json and .git/HEAD are refused. New top-level probe files were writable on the tmpfs skeleton, as designed (agent_sandbox.py:13-16); they were deleted, and existing top-level files such as CLAUDE.md are refused. /proc/sys: 8 tunables openable O_WRONLY, exactly as disclosed in threat-model residual 7 (F-DG0-149, accepted observation). 0 other runs' scratch is visible, peer /proc/<pid>/root of pid 1 is denied, and IPC is unshared. .claude/settings.json allows only Bash(bwrap:*).

summary: PASS with one Low, non-mandatory finding (F-DG0-171). D-044 works as intended. Real annotated-tag objects used as fix_revision (including a tag of a tag) and as head_commit_at_start (on both a verifying and a non-verifying run) are rejected on 331407e for exactly the object-type reason, and the same forgeries were ACCEPTED on the pre-D-044 baseline 49b5ad7. The gate source_commit tag rule (D-037) still holds, and a lightweight tag gives no false positive. The standing controls hold: three unconditional anchors; absent, all-zero and malformed ids rejected; the immutable-field lock; shallow refusal. On the real records, every fix_revision and every retained head_commit_at_start is a commit object, and every dry-run history bucket is 0. F-DG0-171: a review round's source_commit still accepts a tag object, contrary to D-044's 'every commit-id field' wording. It fails closed and is not reachable through the freeze tool. I concur with accepting it as an observation; the auditor must concur, or the orchestrator can fix it. I did not re-verify F-DG0-250, which is qa's finding. Note: review-common.md says 'Review round: 23' but names the round-28 paths. I followed the paths (round 28), which match stages.json.
